newsitem.title: USA: ALUMAX UNIT TO RAISE EXTRUDED PRICES.
newsitem.headline: ALUMAX UNIT TO RAISE EXTRUDED PRICES.

text.p: Alumax Extrusions Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Alumax Inc, on Wednesday said it was increasing prices on all extruded products, including seamless tubular products and Acc-U-Plate, by $0.05 per pound.
The increase applies to new orders entered on or after August 15, and to shipments on or after August 25, the company said.
Open orders placed before August 11, and scheduled to ship by September 6, are not affected by the increase, said the company, which makes soft alloy aluminum extrusions.
